project.description:
A CRM and sales-force-automation domain, and the largest example here: five Souther modules under src/main/souther, compiled together in one build. example.crm holds the shared party vocabulary, the Account, the Contact and the Lead lifecycle including conversion; example.pipeline holds the ten-stage opportunity machine; example.activity the activity log, recency and the next-step playbook; example.quoting the quote lines, the CPQ discount caps and approval; example.forecasting the weighted forecast, fiscal periods and quota attainment. They import in that order — crm is the vocabulary everyone speaks, forecasting sits under a diamond and reaches it three ways. The domain rules are the ones a real CRM enforces: the ten Salesforce stages with their probabilities, conversion reporting every blocking reason rather than the first, duplicate screening that matches accounts on the email domain and contacts on the exact address, and CPQ checking the blended discount as well as each line's.
The boundary is one JUnit smoke test per module and nothing else: no Spring, no jOOQ, no database, no REST. Two of the four injected behaviors are bound from plain Java in the test that needs them, which is all an injected behavior needs to be exercised; the other two are pinned at compile time with `fake` and `example`. Where the language could not state a rule directly, the file's header comment records what had to be written instead and what would let it be written directly — dogfooding the language is why this example is this large.
